messages:
Alex: DeployBot just flagged a checksum mismatch on the airgap bundle for v2.7.1. Packaging team, please advise. We're in the 23:00 UTC change window — should we hold?
DeployBot: preflight FAILED - checksum mismatch for installer.tar.gz (expected sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e but found 3b2e1f4a5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b). Artifact: s3://redwood-release/airgap/v2.7.1/installer.tar.gz
Maria: I can reproduce locally. Looks like gzip metadata changed during packaging (timestamp variance). Holding prod canary for now.
Kevin: Hold agreed. Plan: deterministic gzip + re-sign + update manifest. ETA ~60m.
Nisha: Heads up — KMS rotation is scheduled for tomorrow morning. Avoid overlapping signing ops if we can. Also need release notes updated for on-prem customers.
Sam: Can we pin canary group to v2.7.0 to avoid a rollback if packaging takes long?
Maria: Yes — I'll push a canary pin on the canary route to v2.7.0 for 1h. DeployBot, can you create the rollback tag?
DeployBot: action: created tag v2.7.1-rollback -> v2.7.0 and updated route "canary" to v2.7.0. (ops ticket #R-5543)
Alex: Good. Maria, when you repackage please use `gzip -n` and deterministic tar flags. Also include a build manifest with file sizes and sha256.
Maria: Doing `tar --sort=name --mtime='1970-01-01' --owner=0 --group=0 -cf - . | gzip -n` and then cosign sign. Rebuild started.
Kevin: If packaging >90m we should extend the change window to 02:30 UTC. I'll coordinate with on-call.
Nisha: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for the release notes: "packaging hotfix for deterministic installer; no functional changes." Will also add a note about KMS rotation timing.
DeployBot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-release/airgap/v2.7.1_fix1/installer.tar.gz sha256: abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
Maria: Signed manifest pushed to S3 and cosign verify passes. Running smoke tests now (installer smoke + sample upgrade).
Alex: Share smoke logs here when done. If smoke passes, proceed with staged rollout at 00:10 UTC in three waves (10%, 50%, 100%) with 15m gaps. Make sure monitoring alarms are active.
Sam: I'll coordinate SRE monitoring and set alert thresholds tighter for the first 30m.
Maria: Smoke OK on canary (installer exit 0, apps start). No regressions in basic E2E.
DeployBot: staged rollout initiated: wave1 10% -> in progress.
Alex: Proceed. Update release notes link when you have it.
Nisha: Release notes draft: https://redwood.example/releases/v2.7.1-packaging-hotfix.md — includes changelog, upgrade guidance for airgap customers, and KMS note.
Kevin: Monitoring stable at 10% for 20m. Ready for 50%.
DeployBot: wave1 -> 10% complete; wave2 -> 50% started.
Alex: Thanks all. Keep alerts in this channel for the next hour. We'll keep the rollback tag in case of late issues. Closing thread once rollout completes.
